@final
class Library(Enum):
    """All array libraries explicitly supported by array-api-extra."""

    ARRAY_API_STRICT = "array_api_strict"
    NUMPY = "numpy"
    NUMPY_READONLY = "numpy_readonly"
    CUPY = "cupy"
    TORCH = "torch"
    DASK_ARRAY = "dask.array"
    SPARSE = "sparse"
    JAX_NUMPY = "jax.numpy"

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        """Pretty-print library names."""
        return self.value


_IS_NAMESPACE = {
    Library.CUPY: is_cupy_namespace,
    Library.JAX_NUMPY: is_jax_namespace,
    Library.NUMPY: is_numpy_namespace,
    Library.NUMPY_READONLY: is_numpy_namespace,
    Library.TORCH: is_torch_namespace,
}

CUPY = Library.CUPY
JAX = Library.JAX_NUMPY
NUMPY = Library.NUMPY
TORCH = Library.TORCH

def _delegate(xp: ModuleType, *backends: Library) -> bool:
    """
    Check whether `xp` is one of the `backends` to delegate to.

    Parameters
    ----------
    xp : array_namespace
        Array namespace to check.
    *backends : Library
        Arbitrarily many backends (from the ``Library`` enum) to check.

    Returns
    -------
    bool
        ``True`` if `xp` matches one of the `backends`, ``False`` otherwise.
    """
    return any(_IS_NAMESPACE[backend](xp) for backend in backends)
